about_the_game:
Dip a toe into a world of unique and ingenious dice-based puzzles in this free stand-alone demo of DIE DIE DIE!

Puzzles Within Puzzles

The demo showcases just a handful of mechanics from the full game, but you should still expect to spend at least a couple of hours scratching your head. Possibly a lot longer...

Can you gain control of the blue die, liberate it from its prison, and collect all the elusive bonus coins? The demo gives a taste of the multilayered puzzles found in the full game, where collecting dice lets you solve old puzzles new ways...

No Time Limits

Take your time. Restart or rewind as often as you like. DIE DIE DIE is a test - the test - of spacial reasoning, not your reflexes.

Play How You Like With Full Controller And Steam Deck Support

Play the DIE DIE DIE demo with just the mouse, or connect a gamepad and relax on the couch. With full native Steam Input support and comprehensive in-game controller hints, you'll be solving puzzles in no time! And sipping just 5W of power in Eco mode means your Steam Deck is good for hours (Laptops love it, too).

Colour-Blind Accessible And Misophonia-Friendly

The DIE DIE DIE  demo provides comprehensive support for colour-blind players, including a customisable colour palette and disambiguating pattern overlays. It also allows players who find specific sounds unpleasant to selectively lower or mute them.

No Spoilers

Every puzzle in this stand-alone demo was specially built and does not feature in the full game. And while playing the demo will give you a head-start in learning how to think like a die, don't worry: what you see here is just the very tip of the iceberg...

short_description: The puzzle game for people who like dice... and want to stop. This free stand-alone demo features over twenty unique puzzles not found in the full game. Free the Blue Die! Find all the secrets! Grab your mouse, controller, or Steam Deck and let's roll!
